mainPage.introMessage4: the Life You’ve Always Dreamed Of in Just Minutes.
mainPage.welcomeDescription: Organize your finances, eliminate unnecessary expenses, and achieve your financial goals with a tool that does the work for you in minutes.

content: For years, I thought earning more would fix everything, but the more I earned, the more I spent. Pay raises vanished quickly, and I was still living paycheck to paycheck without knowing where my money was going.

sections.subtitle: The Turning Point:
content: One day, I realized I had to change. A personal finance book shifted my perspective completely.

I cut unnecessary expenses like unused subscriptions and impulse buys. The big change came when I started tracking my expenses, noticing how lifestyle changes and emotions like stress or excitement impacted my spending.

sections.subtitle: The Breakthrough:
content: Tracking brought clarity. I connected my income, spending, and emotions, identified patterns holding me back, and made better decisions.
I saved more, spent less impulsively, and regained control of my finances and life. That’s why I created this tool to help others facing similar struggles.

sections.subtitle: The Solution:
content: This isn’t just a tracker. It’s a tool to understand how your money habits link to your emotions and lifestyle, helping you gain clarity and control—no matter your income.
